# Third-party logos

Official marks of services Lytro integrates with or signs in through. They are other companies' trademarks: use each only to say "works with" or "continue with", in its own colours, never recoloured, stretched, cropped or placed inside a Lytro shape. Before any paid advertising that shows them, check each brand's own usage rules and permission.

| File | Brand | Source | Fetched | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bkash.png | bKash (Bangla wordmark) | Wikimedia Commons, File:BKash-Bangla-Logo-01.png | 2026-10-18 | 1434 x 624, transparent. The English wordmark was not obtainable from bkash.com (403); swap in when the merchant kit is received. |
| nagad.png | Nagad | nagad.com.bd (site logo) | 2026-10-18 | 2400 x 1086, transparent palette PNG. |
| pathao.svg | Pathao | pathao.com/logo.svg | 2026-10-18 | Official SVG. |
| steadfast.svg | Steadfast Courier | steadfast.com.bd home page inline SVG; fills from its stylesheet (ink #2A292B, kite #00BF6F) | 2026-10-18 | Colours were CSS variables on the site and are baked in here. |
| redx.svg | RedX | redx.com.bd/images/redx-logo.svg | 2026-10-18 | Not shown on the landing page until RedX booking is live. |
| google.svg | Google G | Wikimedia Commons, File:Google "G" logo.svg | 2026-10-18 | Sign-in button only. Follow Google's sign-in branding rules in the build. |
| facebook.svg | Facebook f | Wikimedia Commons, File:Facebook f logo (2019).svg | 2026-10-18 | Sign-in button only. Follow Meta's brand rules in the build. |

Rule for the landing page strip: only services that are live appear (bKash, Nagad, Steadfast, Pathao at launch). RedX stays in this folder until its integration ships.
